title: How to Add an Audio Track to Video with Claude MCP and Medux
description: Use a single natural-language request in Claude to upload a silent video and an audio file, call the Medux media tool through MCP, monitor the job, and download a finished MP4 with its new audio track.
operation: Use a single natural-language request in Claude to upload a silent video and an audio file, call the Medux media tool through MCP, monitor the job, and download a finished MP4 with its new audio track.
prompt: Using Medux, add sample-audio.m4a to sample-video-no-audio.mp4. Upload both files with the curl command.
